name: Lacustrine-Mausoleum
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by a nearby asteroid belt. Farther poleward, past massive canyon systems, the silence feels older than the soil.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
